cartridges.title: SG-1000 M2 Check Program (1984)
cartridges.source: the SG-1000 set's 5 Programs & Tools.zip under ~/sms-artifacts/htgdb/, member SG-1000 M2 Test Cartridge (Japan).sg
cartridges.exercises: video memory written and read back through the data port, bit by bit, then a colour screen in Graphics II; on the same board it also checks the processor's RAM, plays each sound channel and reads both joysticks
cartridges.extensionPort: EXTENSION PORT BAD is the board, not this part. At 01FEh the program writes 92h to port DFh, then 55h and AAh to port DEh, reading each back; nothing on the census board answers at DEh, so both reads float and the program calls the port bad.

pages.SCRATCH RAM: run: at 0227h it writes C and reads it back over C000h to C3FFh for C from 00h in steps of 5 while C is below F8h, and prints OK
pages.VDP V-RAM: run: at 028Fh it fills all 16K with 55h, AAh and FFh in Graphics II with the display on, a write every 68 T states, then reads each back every 73 T states; it prints ALL IC OK and the census board counts no lost access
pages.COLOR TEST: stimulus only: colour bars labelled with their index, judged by eye; no verdict
pages.SOUND TEST: stimulus only: each channel sounded in turn, judged by ear; no verdict
pages.I / O TEST: stimulus only: joystick states shown for a person to press; no verdict
pages.EXTENSION PORT: reports BAD on this board, which has nothing at port DEh; the 8255 it probes has no member, so this page waits on one
